# Reach Social — Blog

Operator notes on TikTok Shop from Reach Social (reachsocial.co), a Verified
TikTok Shop Partner for 8- and 9-figure eCommerce brands. $50M+ GMV generated.
Posts are written in the Reach Social company voice; client names anonymized.

## Posts

- [How the TikTok Shop Creator Marketplace Actually Works, Move by Move](https://reachsocial.co/blog/tiktok-shop-creator-marketplace/): How the TikTok Shop Creator Marketplace works in practice for an established brand: sourcing criteria (proven sell-through, category and language fit), seeding cadence (targeted sampling over spray-and-pray), the two-tier commission structure (open affiliate rate vs. a retainer layer of guaranteed content budget for proven performers), and the handoff of organically-proven content into GMV Max - anchored to three real affiliate and creator-seeding case studies (personal care, baby and maternity, health and wellness supplements). Published 2026-08-18.
- [TikTok Shop Live Shopping: What Actually Moves GMV During a Launch](https://reachsocial.co/blog/tiktok-shop-live-shopping/): What a TikTok Shop live shopping launch actually requires for a brand already doing real volume: renting outside hosts instead of building an in-house team, pre-launch affiliate seeding, real-time bid management during the stream, and GMV-per-Live-hour as the one follow-up metric that decides whether to scale - anchored to a real case study where a health and wellness brand went from $0 to $600+ in Live GMV ($170+/hour) in two weeks. Published 2026-08-11.
- [TikTok Shop Seller Fees: What They Actually Cost at Scale](https://reachsocial.co/blog/tiktok-shop-seller-fees/): TikTok Shop's platform fee is a flat 6% referral fee on most US categories (5% on select jewelry, 3% for new sellers' first 30 days), calculated as fee-rate times (customer payment plus platform discount minus tax), with a refund administration fee capped at $5 per SKU. Payment processing figures are inconsistently reported publicly and should be confirmed in Seller Center. The real cost of scale is affiliate commission and ad spend, both of which the brand controls, not TikTok. Published 2026-08-04.
- [What Is GMV Max on TikTok Shop? (And How Two Brands Turned It Into Real Revenue)](https://reachsocial.co/blog/what-is-gmv-max-tiktok-shop/): A plain-language explainer of GMV (gross merchandise value) and GMV Max, TikTok Shop's automated ad product that amplifies content already converting - anchored to two food and beverage brands: one that recovered a broken GMV Max lever (+112% GMV week over week), one that stacked concentrated ad spend with promo and affiliates into a first six-figure month ($100K in 26 days). Published 2026-07-28.
- [How TikTok Shop Affiliate Programs Actually Work (and How to Build One That Converts)](https://reachsocial.co/blog/tiktok-shop-affiliate-program/): How TikTok Shop affiliate programs work — recruiting, sampling, and commission tiers — and the four moves (recruit on data, treat sampling like inventory, build a reactivation cadence, give the roster a home) that turn a stalled program into the channel driving most of a shop's GMV. Published 2026-07-21.
- [What Is a Social Commerce Agency? A Buyer's Checklist for TikTok Shop](https://reachsocial.co/blog/social-commerce-agency/): What a social commerce agency actually does, and the four things to check before signing — a real Creator Engine, affiliate ops as a system, GMV Max fluency, and proof that holds under pressure. Published 2026-07-14.
- [TikTok Shop Strategy for 8- and 9-Figure Brands: Treat It as Retail, Not Social](https://reachsocial.co/blog/tiktok-shop-strategy-retail-not-social/): Why the winning TikTok Shop operating model is retail, not social — the Creator Engine, three revenue lanes (affiliates, shop ops, GMV Max), SKM tier, and a 90-day plan. Published 2026-07-08.
